tracks.title: Last Ride Of The Boogie Child

physical: Pressed by Pathé Marconi EMI, Chatou

sides.side: A Side label, tracklist for B side

notes.text:
Recording locations:
Tracks A1 to A3: Seasalter Free Festival 1976
Track B1: Le Palace Théâtre Paris, 18/2/77
Track B2: not specified

Above tracklist from labels.
A2 is listed on sleeve as Metro/Logic.
B1 is listed on the label as Synthese Intemporelle (Crystal Machine Live At Palace, 18/2/77) 
and on the sleeve as Synthese Intemporel (Le Palace Théâtre Paris, 18/2/77).

p 1977 Tim Blake Productions
Distribution CPF - Egg/Barclay

Side B has a locked groove.
